definitions.explanation: Relating to the third power in mathematics, or a three-dimensional cube shape. Used as a prefix for cubic measurements.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{立方|りっぽう}メートルだ。
examples.english: This tank is one cubic meter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立方体|りっぽうたい}→立方体：05549_rippoutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧し⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Calculate the volume of the cube.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使用量|しようりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧か{月|げつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧10{立方|りっぽう}メートルだった。
examples.english: Water usage was about 10 cubic meters per month.

notes:
Used in mathematics and measurement to indicate cubic (three-dimensional) quantities. Essential for understanding water bills, construction measurements, and math class in Japan. Often written as {立方|りっぽう} or abbreviated as {立米|りゅうべい} (cubic meter) in industry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立方|りっぽう}メートル: cubic meter
- {立方|りっぽう}⟦センチメートル→センチメートル：23738_senchimeetoru⟧: cubic centimeter
- ⟦{立方体|りっぽうたい}→立方体：05549_rippoutai⟧: cube (geometric shape)
- ⟦{立方根|りっぽうこん}→立方根：30121_rippoukon⟧: cube root

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平方|へいほう}→平方：27997_heihou⟧: square (two-dimensional) — ⟦{平方|へいほう}メートル→平方メートル：03148_heihoumeetoru⟧ is square meter
- ⟦{立体|りったい}→立体：18797_rittai⟧: three-dimensional; solid — describes shapes that have depth, broader than {立方|りっぽう}
